1.name: Speed Boost
1.desc: When placed during an operation, significantly increases the movement speed allied poltergeists that pass through it. Tales of the Paranormal - A Slightly Paranormal State of Affairs event item. Removed after the event ends.

2.name: Barricade
2.desc: When placed during an operation, blocks poltergeists from passing through that location. Tales of the Paranormal - A Slightly Paranormal State of Affairs event item. Removed after the event ends.

3.name: Gigantifier
3.desc: When placed during an operation, increases the size of allied poltergeists that pass through it. Tales of the Paranormal - A Slightly Paranormal State of Affairs event item. Removed after the event ends.

4.name: Speed Training
4.desc: When purchased, permanently increases the movement speed of your allied poltergeists. Tales of the Paranormal - A Slightly Paranormal State of Affairs event item. Removed after the event ends.
